data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘Arf’, meaning ‘to exalt’ or ‘to be sublime’. In Islamic tradition, Arfaah represents the virtue of spiritual elevation and righteousness. The name Arfaah carries the meaning “Exalted, Sublime” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Arfaah usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, sublime and live with faith, good character and purpose.
